CustomField.description: Order of this page within its Form Template, lowest first. Stage records follow it through their Sort Order formula, so the stages overview matches. Leave gaps (10, 20, 30) so pages can be inserted later; equal positions give an unpredictable order. The page section configurator also renumbers pages when they are moved in bulk.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a number that sets this page's order in the form (lower numbers come first). Use increments of 10 (10, 20, 30) so you can insert pages later without renumbering, and avoid duplicate values, which make page and stage ordering unpredictable.
CustomField.label: Position
